content.comment_body: I tested this setup and it works during simulation, but fails when I physically connect start/stop pushbuttons to inputs 1 and 2. Can someone help explain why this happens?

analysis.insight_summary: Users notice a mismatch between simulation results and actual device behavior when using pushbuttons as inputs on [product_name]. While simulations indicate proper function, real-world implementation does not, causing confusion and highlighting a gap between simulation and reality for this product.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that functionality proven in simulation will work the same way after deploying to physical hardware, enabling a smooth transition from design to real-world application.
